name: All The Things You Said
source:
This tiny bitsy novel picks up on the story of Lola, a queer sexworker. After meeting with Emily, who was supposed to be her last client, Lola returns to her apartment, where she accidentally runs into her roommate and their new partner.

[From [url=https://lostlesbian.itch.io/all-the-things-you-said]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这部小小说讲述了酷儿性工作者萝拉的故事。在与本应是她最后一个客户的艾米丽会面后，萝拉回到了她的公寓，在那里她意外地遇到了她的室友和他们的新伴侣。

[来自[url=https://lostlesbian.itch.io/all-the-things-you-said]Itch.io[/url]]
